tei:div.tei:p: "!# thugs rje chen po 'khor ba las sgrol las: bla ma pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gtso 'khor gyi las byang dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ྈ ma hā ghu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i dpal: gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dul: rdo rje'i bla ma la btud nas: de nyid las byang rim pa bri: 'di la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes: sngon 'gro sgrub rdzas skyabs sems dang: bgegs bskrad mchod pa byin rlabs dang: bshags pa bya ba rnams yin no: dngos gzhi bskyed dang spyan 'dren dang: bzhugs phyag phyi nang mchod pa dang: bstod pa rnams kyi las rim mo: rjes la tshogs mchod skong ba bskul: dngos grub blang dang chad mdo dang: brtan skyong rta bro dkyil 'khor bsdu: bkra shis smon lam gdab pa 'o: ghu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor sa chog sogs spyi dang mthun zhing: dkyil 'khor lte ba chos 'byung rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa: de'i phyi rim pad+ma 'dab drug: de'i phyi rim 'dab ma lnga: de'i phyi rim pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad: sgo rta babs pad rdor me ri sogs zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor spyi dang mthun pa'i dbus su: bum pa bum rdzas kyis gang ba mañji'am khri'i steng du dar dmar mgul chings dang bcas te bzhugs: g.yas su gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba: g.yon du bdud rtsi'i bhan+dha: mtha' skor du sman gtor rak+ta phyi nang mchod rdzas rgyas par bkram: de nas sgrub pa po bde ba'i stan la 'dug ste: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song bas: bgegs la gtor ma sbyin zhing bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs: byang chub bsgrub la mi dga' zhing: lus sems sbyor ba ngan pa yis: dkyil 'khor lha la mi mos shing: gsang sngags chos la mi dad pa'i: bdud dang 'byung po gang yin pa: mchod sbyin gtor mas mgu gyis la: gnas 'di'i 'khor yug tshun chad du: skad cig tsam yang 'da' ma byed: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: dbang chen sku yi 'od zer las: khro chung mtshon cha 'bar ba yis:

'jig rten khams kun yongs bkang ste: mtshon cha 'bar bas 'joms 'gyur zhing: sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur: dkyil 'khor 'jug par mi dbang zhing: gsang sngags chos la mi dad pa'i: log par lta ba gang yin pa: skad cig nyid la phyir dengs shig: ces pa'i sham bur hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad: de nas phyi mtshams ni: rgyal po chen po bzhi pho brang gi phyogs bzhir bskyed de: hūm̐: sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas stobs po che: yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po: spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras: ri rab gling bzhi'i ngos bzhi nas: phyag na rdo rje'i dbang gi mthus: bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i: phyogs skyong rgyal po chen po bzhi: bdag cag bar chad srung ba'i phyir: ma dag 'khor rnams mtshams chod cig: oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa: bai ru ḍha ka: bi ru pāk+ṣa: be shra ma ṇa badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas nang mtshams ni: hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams bcu po ru: hūm̐ las skyes pa'i khro bo bcu: hūm̐ kar stobs chen rnam par rgyal: gshin rje rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil: dbyug sngon mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dang: khams gsum rnam rgyal la sogs pa: 'jigs byed 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gdon bgegs rnams: drag shul stobs kyis mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra sarba kro ta badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas gsang ba'i mtshams ni: khro bcu'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer rdo rje'i rang bzhin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas: gzhal yas khang gi steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang du gyur: hūm̐: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las las: rang byung dpal du shar ba yi: khro bo bcu yi thugs ka nas: 'od zer stong khams khyab par 'phros: snang srid rab 'jigs gzhal yas khang: snod bcud he ru ka dpal sku: dur khrod 'bar ba'i sa gzhi la: sra brtan rdo rje'i gzhal yas gyur:

hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra tsakra tīk+ṇa badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag lha yi gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad rang rig he ru ka: rang rig rang gsal brda' sgo da phyes shig: bh+rūm̐ saṃ krita dz+nyā na pra be sha ya phaṭa: de nas byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: pad+ma badz+ra dkyil 'khor lha: chos sku skye med ngang nyid las: bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku ston: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang: kun 'dus bdag nyid bla ma dang: ma dang mkha' 'gro tshogs dang bcas: byin chen rnams kyis byin phob la: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur te: rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor 'dir: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ.ā be sha ya a ā: de nas mchod pa'i bye brag bdud rtsi dang mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ bigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐: oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhāt+s+ma wa shud+dho3 haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa'i dbyibs can: mchog ma gnyis dang chang bzung gnyis la yaṃ gyis mtshan: de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa: de'i steng du keṃ gsum las byung ba'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu ri rab dang mnyam pa kha phyir bstan pa gsum gyi steng du: āḥlas bhan+dha yangs shing rgya che ba rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba: de'i nang du shar du ha las glang po che'i sha: lhor bi las rta'i sha: nub tu ku las khyi'i sha: byang du da las ba lang gi sha: dbus su na las mi yi sha: shar lhor shu las byang sems dkar po shel lta bu: lho nub tu bi las dri chen gser lta bu: nub byang du ra las rak+ta mdangs ldan dmar po: byang shar du mu las dri chu sngon po in+d+ra nī la'i mdangs lta bu:

slar dbus su ma las klad pa dung la pho tshos byugs pa lta bu ste: sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lngas yongs su gang ba: de'i nang du dbus su hūm̐ muṃ mthing ga: shar du oṃ lāṃ dkar po: lho ru trāṃ māṃ ser po: nub tu hrīḥpāṃ dmar po: byang du hā tāṃ ljang gu: ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin hūm̐ āṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ haṃ ā: de la nyi ma'i kha chod ak+ṣa lnga bcus mtshan pa gcig tu gyur: de las bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od zer 'phros: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon: rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: yaṃ la phog rlung g.yos: raṃ las me 'bar thod pa'i nang gi rdzas khol mi gtsang ba'i dri ma thams cad lbu ba'i rnam par phyir bo: rigs lnga yab yum gyi sku las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab: rgyu'i sa bon nyi zla'i kha chod ak+ṣa lnga bcu dang bcas pa'ang 'od du zhu: ye shes kyi bdud rtsi sman gtor rak+ta'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛta ma hā ba liṃ ta: ma hā rak+ta sarba pū tsa kha kha khā hi khā hi: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra pā d+yaṃ= badz+ra pūṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= ghan+dhe= nai bed+ya= shab+da aḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañca pū tsa ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bho dhi tsit+ta gha na gu h+ya pū tsa ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pū tsa ho: bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen pos nam mkha'i khams gang bas phyogs dus bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la mchod pas mnyes par gyur: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod: ye nas rang byung rang las shar ba'i phyir: stong pa'i ngang du ma 'dres rang gsal gdab:

hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri bā ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: de nas bskyed rim ni: hūm̐: spros med yang dag de bzhin nyid: rang bzhin lhun grub chos kyi sku: mnyam yangs phyogs bral kun khyab ngang: ma bcos spros bral de bzhin nyid: rang rig chos sku bde ba che: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃḥ hūm̐: thams cad khyab gdal chos sku'i ngang: rang rig chos sku'i nam mkha' la: e las chos kyi 'byung gnas che: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang: raṃ las me yi dkyil 'khor dmar: baṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor sngo: laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor ser: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab dang: raṃ las ye shes me 'od 'bar: sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram steng: yi ge bh+rūm̐ gyi 'phro 'du las: rin chen sna lnga las grub pa: sna tshogs rdo rje'i brtsigs pa las: 'gyur med rdo rje'i rgya yis btab: tshad med bzhi ldan sgo bzhi'i steng: rta babs snam bu bcu gsum mdzes: rdo rje'i thog ni phyogs mdog la: yid bzhin nor bu'i tog gis mtshan: 'dod yon snam bu dmar po la: ye shes mkha' 'gro gar gyis rol: ka ba ka rgyan rab mdzes shing: rta babs chos 'khor gdugs tog mdzes: pho brang gzhi yang 'od du 'bar: dur khrod brgyad sogs dkyil 'khor rdzogs: ye shes lnga rdzogs me dpung dbus: bde gshegs kun 'dus pho brang gsal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe e dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la: a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la: paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa ho: de nas lha bskyed bdag bskyed ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin lhun grub dkyil 'khor dbus: pad+ma rin chen 'bar ba'i steng: ti ra nyi zla pad steng du: yi ge hrīḥyi 'phro 'du las: rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: sku mdog dmar po zhi ma khro: mche ba'i myu gu rnam par gtsigs: spyan gsum ldan zhing dbu skra ni: mthon mthing ral pa spyi bor bcings:

yid bzhin nor bu dbang gis brgyan: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu ni: thabs shes dbyer med yum la 'khyud: zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang rol: de yi pang na ye shes kyi: mkha' 'gro lha lcam man+dha ra: sku mdog dmar mo byi ru'i mdog: phyag g.yas cang te'u mkha' la 'khrol: phyag g.yon bdud rtsi yab la stob: zhabs gnyis yab la dgyes par 'khril: skra grol bha ga nu ma rgyas: yab yum gnyis med rin chen dang: rus pa'i rgyan drug dar sogs brgyan: 'od zer mdangs dang ldan par bskyed: shar du pad+ma nyi zla la: mi yi gu ru pad+ma 'byung: dkar dmar mdangs ldan rdo rje dang: ka li zab ber chos gos can: pad zhwa rab spras skyil krung bskyed: lho phyogs pad+ma nyi zla la: lha min gu ru rnam par rgyal: mdog ljang rdo rje ka li bsnams: rus rgyan dar sogs zhi khro'i chas: rab spras skyil krung bzhugs par bskyed: nub kyi pad+ma nyi zla la: byol song ghu ru seng ha brtan: mdog mthing cang te'u dril bu bsnams: rus pa'i rgyan spras zhabs gnyis po: brkyang bskum 'gying ba'i tshul du bskyed: byang phyogs pad+ma nyi zla la: yi dwags gu ru rnam snang byed: smug nag lcags phur rdo rje bsnams: rin chen dar zab rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs par bskyed: steng phyogs pad+ma nyi zla la: lha yi ghu ru gser thub 'dzin: sku mdog dkar ser rdor dril bsnams: rin chen ut+pal rgyan gyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar stabs bzhugs par bskyed: 'og phyogs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: dmyal ba'i ghu ru rnam par gnon: dmar nag rdo rje sdig pa bsnams: dur khrod chas brgyad rgyan gyis brgyan: zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs bzhugs par bskyed: de yi phyi rim pad skor la: shar du rdo rje thod phreng dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sems skyil bzhugs: rtsa phyag rdor dril thugs kar bsnams: mtha' gnyis kha ṭ+wāṃ ral gri phyar:

rin chen rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes: lho phyogs rat+na thod phreng ser: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sems skyil bzhugs: rtsa phyag nor bu rin chen phyar: mtha' gnyis zhags pa ral gri bsnams: rin chen rgyan dang na bzas mdzes: nub tu pad+ma thod phreng dmar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sems skyil bzhugs: rtsa phyag pad+ma dril bu phyar: mtha' gnyis gri gug lcags sgrog 'dzin: rin chen rgyan dang na bzas mdzes: byang du karma thod phreng ljang: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sems skyil bzhugs: rtsa phyag rgya gram ral gri phyar: mtha' gnyis shes rab mda' gzhu 'gengs: rin chen rgyan dang na bzas mdzes: thugs kar bud+dha thod phreng mthing: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sems skyil bzhugs: rtsa phyag rdo rje dril bu 'chang: mtha' gnyis 'khor lo rgya gram 'dzin: rin chen na bza'i rgyan gyis spras: kun kyang 'dzum khro 'od lnga'i klong: phrin las lnga yis don mdzad phyir: gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan par bskyed: de yi pad skor phyi ma la: 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad dang: phyogs bzhi 'dab bzhi mkha' 'gro ging: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: rigs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan 'dzin: brkyang bskum sna tshogs gar gyis rol: chos skyong rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i tshogs: bsam gyis mi khyab yongs rdzogs gtibs: ye shes lnga yi dbang rdzogs shog: ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐: hrīḥgu ru pad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃ dza: de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: nub phyogs o rgyan dbang gi dbyings kyi klong: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: bde gshegs kun gyi phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: o rgyan bla ma zhi khro'i skur bstan pa: pad+ma badz+ra gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: lha yi 'gro ba ma lus 'dul mdzad cing: 'chi 'pho ltung byed sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa:

gser thub 'dzin pa 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: lha min 'gro ba ma lus 'dul mdzad cing: 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal ma lus zhi mdzad pa: rnam par rgyal ba 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: 'gro ba mi rnams ma lus 'dul mdzad cing: skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa yi: pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: byol song 'gro ba ma lus 'dul mdzad cing: bkol spyod sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa yi: seng ha rab brtan 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: yi dwags 'gro ba ma lus 'dul byed pa'i: bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa yi: rnam par snang byed 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: dmyal ba'i 'gro ba ma lus 'dul mdzad cing: tsha grang sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzad pa yi: rnam par gnon pa 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: mi mjed 'jig rten zhing khams dam pa nas: bstan gnyis rgya mtsho gsal bar mdzad pa yi: sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: mkha' spyod phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i zhing khams nas: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun grub 'gro don mdzad: thod phreng rigs lnga 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: snang ba'i ngo bo dpal chen he ru ka: stong pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje phag mo yum: thabs shes dbyer med bde ba mchog gi sku: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa: bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad ma: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho dang: gter srung bka' nyan 'khor tshogs gshegs su gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hrīḥghu ru pad+ma badz+ra shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra sarba sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho:

bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun 'dus phrin las kun gyi bdag: bla ma pad+ma badz+ra dkyil 'khor lha: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas 'dir: nyi zla pad+ma mdzes pa'i gdan steng du: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin sku: kun mkhyen bdag nyid rdo rje 'dzin: pad+ma badz+ra la phyag 'tshal: 'gro drug sems can don mdzad phyir: pha rol phyin drug gzhan don mdzad: gang 'dul tshul du skur bstan pa: 'gro drug don mdzad la phyag 'tshal: dug lnga 'joms phyir sku lnga dang: rnam shes tshogs brgyad mtshan brgyad sprul: thabs shes dbyer med yi dam lha: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la phyag 'tshal: shrī pad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra a ti pū ho: pra tits+tsha ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: yon chab me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas sgra snyan la sogs yid 'ong rnams: phyi yi mchod pa dam pa bla na med: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: rang snang dag pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hrīḥgu ru pad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā: pūṣ+pe= dhu pe= ā lo ke= ghan+dhe= nai bid+yā= shab+da pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā: hrī: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa: dbang po lnga yi longs spyod 'dod dgur ldan: rang byung nang mchod dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don phyir bzhes mdzod la: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po la sogs pa: phrin las gang yang thogs med 'grub gyur cig: bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen rab 'phel nas: bdag gzhan don gyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hrīḥgu ru pad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra rū pa=

badz+ra shab+da= badz+ra ghan+dhe= badz+ra ra sa= badz+ra spar+she= pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā: hrī: khrag zhag ar+ghaṃ dbang po'i me tog dang: gsur chen bdug spos zhun chen snang gsal me: rdo rje dri chu mkhris pa'i dri chab dang: rdo rje dri chen māṃ sa zhal zas dang: rkang gling thod rnga la sogs mchod chen po: byang sems dkar dmar ga pur dmar chen zil: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nga rgyal che: phrag dog la sogs nyon mongs mchod pa'i rdzas: gsang ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul lags na: bla ma dkyil 'khor lha yis bzhes nas kyang: nyon mongs ye shes chen por dbang bskur zhing: bde stong zag med dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra gha ṇa ghu h+ya pū tsa āḥhūm̐ swā hā: de nas sman mchod 'bul ba ni: oṃ: bhan+dha 'khor yug yangs pa'i snod nang du: gdod nas rnam dag bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang: lha sngags ting 'dzin yig 'brus byin gyis brlabs: me rlung sbyor bas bkug bstims bsre bsnan byas: ye shes lha rnams dgyes pa skong byed cing: gang la 'brel rnams don chen 'grub byed 'di: gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra rtsal la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol: 'gro drug don mdzad ghu ru drug la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang= phrin las sgrub pa'i thod phreng rigs lngar 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos= tshogs brgyad rnam dag mtshan brgyad tshogs la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs dbang dang dngos= yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs= mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs= gter srung bka' nyan bka' sdod tshogs la 'bul: thugs rjes brtser dgongs= hrīḥghu ru badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra sarba pañca a mṛta la khā hi: de nas rak+ta 'bul ba ni: ā: 'dod chags rnam dag pad+ma rak+ta ni:

rgyu drug kun sgrol khams gsum dbang du sdud: bde mchog bde spyod rak+ta'i mchod pa ni: pad+ma badz+ra dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: khams gsum srid gsum dbang gi dngos grub stsol: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: de nas sgrub pa po rnams kyis gnas gsum du bdud rtsi dang rak+ta'i thig le byas la: hrī: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta dngos grub rdzas: ye shes lha rnams dgyes pa bskangs nas kyang: bdag cag bu la thugs rjes brtser dgongs nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: sid+dhi pha la kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra a: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hrī: bhan+dha gtor gzhong yangs pa'i snod chen du: sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar gtor mar bshams: ting 'dzin me rlung sbyor bas bsregs sbyangs shing: ye shes bkug cing gnyis su med par bsres: byin rlabs bcud dang ldan pa'i gtor chen po: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams kyis rab spras pa: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs: bla med chos kyi longs spyod mkho dgur ldan: rgyan mdzes bkod legs yid 'ongs gtor ma 'di: gtso mchog pad+ma badz+ra rtsal la 'bul: gnyis med gsang ba'i lha lcam yum la 'bul: 'gro drug don mdzad gu ru drug la 'bul: rnam shes rnam dag mtshan brgyad tshogs la 'bul: phrin las lnga mdzad thod phreng rigs lngar 'bul: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul: bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: chos skyong gter bdag bka' sdod tshogs la 'bul: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs sku lnga'i bdag nyid 'chang: rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: dri med mdangs ldan pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: zhi khro'i tshul can spyan gsum zhal 'dzum bzhad:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams: thabs shes gnyis med zung 'jug brda yi tshul: ye shes lnga ldan rigs lngas dbu la brgyan: longs spyod rab rdzogs dar gyi cod pan 'phur: pha rol phyin drug rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: dbu skra gyen 'khyil mthon mthing thor cog can: mdzes pa'i sku la zhi khro'i rgyan gyis spras: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bde chen rol par bzhugs: gtso bo mchog gi sku la mnyam sbyor ba: gsang ba'i yum mchog lha lcam man+dha ra: gzhon tshul lang tsho bcu drug ldan pa'i sku: bye ru'i mdog can dbu skra thur du 'phyang: bde ba'i rang bzhin nu ma bha ga rgyas: dgyes pa'i tshul gyis yab kyi zhal dang sbyor: phyag g.yas cang te'u 'gro kun gnyid las slong: g.yon pa thod pa'i bdud rtsi yab la stob: pha rol phyin drug rin chen rgyan drug mdzes: zung 'jug bde chen zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: gnyis med bde chen 'gro 'dul rol pa'i gar: yab yum gnyis med sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: pha rol phyin pa shes rab rang bzhin te: shes bya'i don rnams ma lus kun mkhyen cing: 'chi 'pho ltung byed sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: gu ru gser thub 'dzin gyi sku la bstod: pha rol phyin pa tshul khrims rang bzhin te: zhi rgyas dbang drag 'gro kun thabs kyis 'dul: sprul sku mtshan dpe ldan pa'i tshul 'chang ba: gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la bstod: pha rol phyin pa bzod pa'i rang bzhin sku: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis 'dul mdzad cing: lha min 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa: gu ru rnam par rgyal ba'i sku la bstod: pha rol phyin pa bsam gtan rang bzhin te: nyon mongs gnyid slong ye shes sgron me spor: dud 'gro bkol spyod sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa'i: gu ru seng ha rab brtan sku la bstod: pha rol phyin pa sbyin pa'i rang bzhin te: khams gsum srid gsum kun la dbang sgyur nas: yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal zhi mdzad pa:

ghu ru rnam par snang byed sku la bstod: pha rol phyin pa brtson 'grus rang bzhin sku: rab 'jigs khro rgyal dpa' gtum rngam stabs can: dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal skyob mdzad pa: ghu ru rnam par gnon gyi sku la bstod: snang ba ma 'gag rang rig he ru ka: stong pa'i rang bzhin shes rab dpa' mo che: snang stong zung 'jug thabs shes skur ston pa: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la bstod: bka' bzhin rjes su sgrub pa'i grogs mdzad ma: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod: de nas ghu ru thod phreng rigs lnga dang mtshan brgyad kyi bstod pa ni: hūm̐: dus gsum bde gshegs rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: 'gro ba'i don du sku lnga sprul mdzad nas: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun grub la sogs pa: phrin las lnga la mnga' mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod: nad gdon bar chad ma lus zhi mdzad pa: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: tshe dbang longs spyod ma lus rgyas mdzad pa: rat+na thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal la= mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las tshar gcod mdzad: karma thod phreng rtsal la= thams cad ma lus lhun gyis grub mdzad pa: bhud+dha thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: 'khor bar ma chags skyon gyis ma gos pa'i: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yon tan thams cad ma lus thugs la rdzogs: pad+ma sam bha'i sku la phyag 'tshal= phyi nang shes bya'i chos kun thams cad mkhyen: blo ldan mchog sred sku la= khams gsum srid gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa: pad+ma rgyal po'i sku la= phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa: nyi ma 'od zer sku la= log 'dren bdud bzhi ma lus 'dul mdzad pa: shākya seng ge'i sku la= lta log mu stegs thams cad tshar gcod pa: seng ge sgra sgrog sku la= lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa: rdo rje gro lod sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:

de nas tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni: hrī: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes ting 'dzin gyis: 'khor 'das chos rnams sgyu mar rig pa'i phyir: bsregs sbyangs bkrus pas ma dag gang yang med: de phyir 'dir bshams tshogs kyi yo byad kyi: dngos dang dngos min bag chags ma lus kun: raṃ las me byung nyon mongs bag chags bsregs: yaṃ las rlung byung dngos 'dzin zhe sdang stong: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog bkrus: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsreg cing gtor dang bkrus: dag cing gtsang la rnyogs pa med par byas: raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐: yak+ṣa hūm̐: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ sarba dra byaṃ saṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa: de nas byin gyis brlab pa ni: gtor ma ltar bya zhing: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: oṃ las 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga: hūm̐ gis zag med ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur: trāṃ las 'dzad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs: hrīḥyis mgron rnams rang bzhin gnas nas bkug: āḥyis so sor ci 'dod dgyes pa skong: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: ye shes rnam pa lnga yi rang bzhin la: zhal zas byin rlabs dngos po yi ge lnga: sgra dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams 'od du zhu: ye shes 'od phung 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis: rgyal ba rnams kyi dgyes pa bskang gyur cig: ma tshogs mkha' 'gro thams cad tshim gyur cig: de nas spyan drang ba ni: hrī: dus gsum bde gshegs bcom ldan 'das: pad+ma badz+ra yab yum dang: 'khor tshogs rig 'dzin bla ma lha: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang: mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs: zhal zas tshogs la gshegs su gsol: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dza: de nas tshogs 'bul ba ni: hrī: sangs rgyas bde gshegs ma lus kun 'dus pa:

pad+ma badz+ra yab yum bcas rnams la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'gro drug don mdzad gu ru drug rnams la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: shes brgyad rnam dag sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos bstsal du gsol: phrin las lnga mdzad thod phreng rigs lnga la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha tshogs la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol du gsol: bar chad sel ba'i mkha' 'gro chos skyong la: 'dod yon zhas zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol du gsol: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i gter srung bka' sdod la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol du gsol: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra gha ṇa tsakra pū tsa la khā hi: de nas skong ba ni: hrīḥ bskang ngo bskal par thugs dam bskang ba ni: 'dod yon tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang: bla ma pad+ma badz+ra'i lha tshogs dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag rnams: zhal zas tshogs gtor mchod pas thugs dam bskang: longs spyod ting 'dzin cho gas thugs dam bskang: dza gad bdud rtsi rak+tas thugs dam bskang: sgrub dang dam tshig glu gar phyag rgya dang:

skong ba'i rdzas mchog rnams kyis thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskangs nas nyams chag sor stsol nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas bshags pa ni: hrī: bdag cag ma rig lus dang ngag sems kyis: bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur te: pad+ma badz+ra yab yum 'khor bcas dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag sogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dang ci 'gal ba: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pas mthol zhing bshags: mthol bshags bzod pa dang du yar bzhes la: sgrib med tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ga ṇa tsakra sid+dhi sa ma ya a a: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me: tsit+taṃ shre yaṃ ku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta: hṝ da ya: badz+ra mā me muñca: badz+rī bha wa: ma hā sa ma ya: satwa a: ces sogs rnams kyis nyams chag bshags par bya: de nas bsgral mchod ni: tshogs zan la dgra bo'i gzugs bcos pa mdun du bzhag cing dgug pa'i dmigs pa dang: lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bstan te bden stobs brjod:

badz+ra sarba sha trūṃ a mu ka nṛ tri aṃ ku sha dza: zhes pas dmigs bya'i rnam shes bkug la: badz+ra pā sha hūm̐ zhes zhags pas bcing: de bzhin: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ zhes pas lcags sgrog gi phyag rgyas lus ngag yid gsum bsdam: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: dril bu'i phyag rgyas rnam shes phyes dbyer med bsre: de nas ngag gis 'di ltar zer bar bya: oṃ pad+ma badz+ra hrīḥdhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī ghu ru sarba hrīḥm ḍā ka ḍā ki nī ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hri ya: h+ya grī wa bhā ra hī badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor: mi bzad 'jigs pa'i skur ston cing: dmar nag me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro: khro bo'i gzugs kyis gnam sa gang: sku stod zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rdo rje dril bu bsnams pa ste: sku smad ye shes phur pa de: nam mkha'i mthongs nas bsgril zhing 'debs: drag po'i phur pa tshwa tshwa 'phro: btab pa tsam gyis lha yang brlag: dgra dang bgegs la smos ci dgos: rgya mdud dbyings nas 'brug stong ldir: chang gzung mtshams nas glog stong 'khyug: chu srin kha nas tshwa tshwa 'phro: mtshon cha'i 'od zer skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bgegs steng du mā ra ya: sarba sha trūṃ a mu ka nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dza: gnod byed dgra bgegs che ge mo mā ra ya rbad: che ge mo 'go ba'i lha dang phrol cig: skyob pa'i grogs dang phrol cig: lus ngag yid gsum thal bar rlogs shig dgra bgegs nri tri tsit+ta sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: de nas bstab pa ni: hrī: bla ma pad+ma badz+ra lha tshogs dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag rnams: 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad zhal phyes shig: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i gzugs phung zhal du bstab: zhal du bzhes shig rol cig kha raṃ khā hi: hrīḥpad+ma badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: ma hā tsit+ta khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na khā hi:

ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti khā hi: ma hā ba su ta khā hi: de nas rim pa bzhin tshogs drang ba sogs thugs rje chen po'i las byang ngam rgyal ba 'dus pa'i las byang bzhin bya'o: de nas lhag gtor gtang ba ni: bh+yo: dang por phud kyis mi mchod du: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs phud kyi bdag: bar du lhag mas mi mchod du: ma mo mkha' 'gro lhag la dgyes: tha mar gcig tu mi bsre ru: 'khor 'das phyam brdal ro gcig ngang: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma: las bzhi'i mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong byed tshogs: dam tshig can gyi grogs mdzad ma: dam nyams srog gcod bka' chad 'beb: 'dir gshegs lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sarba ḍā ki nī u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bha liṃ ta khā hi: de nas 'dzab bzla ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ghu ru shrī pad+ma badz+ra hrīḥdhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī na ma swā hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ bhud+dha ghu ru sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ghu ru sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ rat+na ghu ru sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ pad+ma ghu ru sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ karma ghu ru sid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba ghu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: de ni bsnyen pa'o: de nas sgrub pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ghu ru shrī pad+ma badz+ra hrī: dhu ma gha ye ḍā ki nī ma hā ghu ru badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bud+dha sarba sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de nas las sbyor ni: hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya: shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ bā shaṃ mā ra ya sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: gang 'dod sham bu skabs dang sbyor la bzla /de nas bskul bya ba ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs pa bla ma'i tshogs: pad+ma badz+ra yab yum 'khor tshogs rnams: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: bskul lo 'gro ba sems can don du bskul: mdzod cig mngon spyod drag po'i las mdzod cig: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la:

rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mgon du sbran: gnod byed gdug pa'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rmad po che: 'bad rtsol med par dus 'dir 'grub pa'i phyir: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas dngos grub blang ba ni: gtor ma rang ngam gzhan gyi spyi gtsug tu bzhag la: hūm̐: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: dgos 'dod 'byung ba yid bzhin nor bu'i mchog: pad+ma badz+ra yab yum sras 'khor rnams: sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las dbang mchog de: sgrub mchog rdzas la brten nas bstsal du gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dam pa de: sgrub mchog rdzas la brten nas bstsal du gsol: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i dngos grub de: sgrub mchog rdzas la brten nas bstsal du gsol: de nas chad mdo'i gtor ma gtang ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe che mchog pad+ma he ru yis: khams gsum dbang bsdus srid gsum zil gnon tshe: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las rigs sogs: mkha' 'gro ma sring dam can rgya mtsho yis: so sor khas blangs gnyer len byas pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas bstan bsrung rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par chad pa bzhin: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di longs la: sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod: de 'og ra sa 'phrul snang steng khang du: slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mnga' bdag yab sras mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs la: 'khor ba las sgrol rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyi: dbang dang bskyed rdzogs smin grol bkod pa'i tshe: ma hā kā la dpal mgon bdun cu yis: so sor khas blangs gnyer len byas pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas bstan bsrung rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par chad pa bzhin: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di blangs nas: sngon tshe tha tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod: de 'og lnga brgya snyigs ma rtsub 'gyur dus:

rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng gis: slob ma rig 'dzin zhig po gling pa la: snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dul gdung gsob dbang bskur tshe: bka' srung lha mgon gter srung thams cad kyis: so sor khas blangs gnyer len byas pa'i tshe: sangs rgyas bstan bsrung rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par chad pa bzhin: dam rdzas rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di blangs nas: sngon tshe tha tshig bzhin du phrin las mdzod: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan bdud mo chen mo bzhi: gnod sbyin bzhi dang sman btsun bzhi la sogs: bod khams bstan skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis te: chibs su sha ba rkyang dang 'brong la 'chib: zas su gser skyems sha khrag dmar gtor rol: las su sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba yi: gangs ri g.ya' rtse lu ma skyed mos tshal: gnas dang dur khrod chu gling bas mtha' dang: nags chen grog mkhar mchod rten gtsug lag khang: sa 'og sa steng sa bla la sogs pa: phyi nang dben khang sgrub gnas la gnas pa'i: bstan skyong ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang: dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod pa dang: sgrub pa po yi sdong grogs bgyid pa dang: yon gyi bdag po'i bar chad bzlog pa dang: gnod byed dgra bgegs ma lus sgrol la sogs: bcol pa'i las rnams myur du grub par mdzod: de nas rta bro bya ba ni: hrām̐: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung po skye mched la: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rngam brjid rol pa'i gar: khro bo khro mos bro brdung chems se chem: drag po sngags kyi sgra skad di ri ri: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gar byed shigs se shig: pho nya las mkhan rgyug dang springs se spring: dgra bgegs sha khrag dum bu tha ra ra: mched lcam rol pa'i 'cham stabs lams se lam: mnan cing gzir ba'i las kyis don chen 'grub:

gnod byed dgra bgegs sbyor ba rgyun bcad de: dgra bgegs 'byung po s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams mtha' nas rim gyis dkyil 'khor dbus kyi gtso bo la thim: rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs srog hūm̐ du gyur: hūm̐ zla tshes: zla tshes thig le: thig le nā da: nā da chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du gyur: hūm̐: chos sku skye med spros pa'i mtha' bral yang: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i tshul du dkyil 'khor gsal: sprul skus 'gro don lhun grub mthar phyin cing: yang gsang bla ma'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings gsal: skye med chos kyi dbyings su badz+ra mu: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: ā+oṃ: sku lnga'i phrin las lhun grub don mdzad pa: pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi bkra shis shog: gang la gang 'dul de la der ston mdzad: 'gro 'dul gu ru drug gi bkra shis shog: zhi rgyas dbang drag lhun grub las kun 'grub: thod phreng rigs lnga mchog gi bkra shis shog: zhing khams kun tu 'gro don phyogs med mdzad: ghu ru sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad bkra shis shog: mi mthun bar chad phyogs kun sel mdzad pa: 'khor tshogs bka' srung rnams kyi bkra shis shog: de nas smon lam gdab pa ni: na mo: bdag gis rje btsun bla ma bsgrubs: dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa'i: yon tan ma lus kun rdzogs nas: phrin las gang brtsam 'grub par shog: ces smon lam tshigs su bcad pa brjod cing: srung 'khor bsgom zhing rgyun spyod la 'jug par bya: bla ma pad+ma badz+ra 'khor tshogs kyi las byang dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bdag 'dra mtsho rgyal gyis mthing shun sngon po'i leb la yi ger btab pa'o: gsung gi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki nī sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: man+t+ra ghu h+ya: bdag 'dra gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis mthing shun sngon po'i leb nas dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni khro bo dpal gyis bgyis//
